issues.description: Method name mismatch for the order-serving operation on SealSaloon: the problem statement and UML explicitly require a method named checkOrderReady() (used by orderMeal() to serve ready orders). The reference solution instead implements this behavior in a method named processOrders(), and orderMeal() calls processOrders(). This naming divergence between the specification (problem_statement.md) and the solution (SealSaloon.java) can confuse students implementing the required API or cause automated graders/tests that expect checkOrderReady() to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent with the problem statement. Option A (preferable): Rename the solution method processOrders() to checkOrderReady() (signature: public void checkOrderReady()) and ensure orderMeal() calls checkOrderReady(). Option B: Add a public delegating method public void checkOrderReady() { processOrders(); } so the solution exposes the expected name while keeping the internal helper name. Update any documentation/tests accordingly.
